milestone.title: Raul selection, co-approval, and timestamp correctness

intent.outcome: Visible TUI rows and actions always target the same entity; co-approval confirms only after all commands succeed; durable and display timestamps share one strict RFC3339 parser with offset handling.

problem.description: Annotation render uses visible_annotations while selection indexes the raw vector. confirm_co_approval sets confirmed before validation and discards approve errors. mp-model accepts impossible RFC3339 shapes; Raul humanize ignores timezone offsets.

in_scope: Load full thread; filter only client-side
Co-approval Choosing→Executing→Confirmed with failure returning to Choosing
Shared strict RFC3339 parser (T separator; reject space) with calendar and offset validation
Audit milestone/inbox lists for the same raw/visible mismatch
out_of_scope: Lifecycle transition table (Group C beyond shared timestamp/lifecycle helpers)

design_decisions.choice: Define one canonical ordered visible-annotations projection used for rendering, cursor limits, selected_annotation, keyboard actions, and mouse hit testing; preserve selection by annotation ID across filter changes; always load the complete thread and filter only in the client projection.
design_decisions.rationale: Render uses visible_annotations while selection indexes the raw vector, so resolve/reopen/co-approval hit the wrong row (Finding 7A).

design_decisions.choice: Co-approval states are Choosing → Executing → Confirmed; validate before state change; execute resolve/reopen and milestone approve with checked results; mark Confirmed only after the full operation succeeds; failure returns to Choosing with an actionable error and keeps the modal retryable.
design_decisions.rationale: confirm_co_approval sets confirmed before validation and discards mp milestone approve errors (Finding 7B).

design_decisions.choice: Provide one standards-compliant RFC3339 parser at a shared seam (mp-model); validate calendar dates, leap years, time ranges, fractional seconds, and offset ranges; apply offsets to epoch; require strict T separator and reject the relaxed space form; reuse for durable audit timestamps and Raul humanization — no second handwritten datetime.
design_decisions.rationale: mp-model accepts impossible RFC3339 shapes and Raul humanize ignores timezone offsets (Finding 11).

steps.action: Define one canonical ordered visible-annotations projection; use it for rendering, cursor limits, selected_annotation, keyboard actions, and mouse hit testing; preserve selection by annotation ID across filter changes; reset/re-anchor when selected annotation becomes hidden.
steps.done_when: Mixed resolved/open with open-only; filter toggle while cursor on hidden item; keyboard and mouse select the same item; resolve/reopen/co-approval target highlighted row.

steps.action: Always load the complete annotation thread from mp and filter only in the canonical client projection; do not apply open-only filtering in both mp and Raul. Audit milestone and inbox lists for the same raw-list/visible-list mismatch and fix the same way.
steps.done_when: Toggling open-only can reveal previously hidden rows; milestone/inbox lists share ID-keyed visible projection; tui_annotation green.

steps.action: Add crates/raul/tests/tui_annotation_selection.rs with Finding 7A regression cases (mixed filter, cursor re-anchor, resolve/reopen/co-approval target, keyboard/mouse parity).
steps.done_when: New test binary exists and AC-01 -E filter matches ≥1 passing test.

steps.action: Validate annotation, milestone, and selected action before changing co-approval state; execute resolve/reopen and milestone approval with checked results; do not discard mp milestone approve errors; mark confirmed only after full success; keep modal retryable on failure with actionable error; refresh annotations best-effort without masking primary error.
steps.done_when: States are Choosing→Executing→Confirmed; failure returns to Choosing; enter-without-choice and command failures covered.

steps.action: Add crates/raul/tests/tui_co_approval.rs covering enter-without-choice, resolve/reopen failure, approve failure, retry after failure, and full success marks confirmed exactly once.
steps.done_when: New test binary exists and AC-02 -E filter matches ≥1 passing test.

steps.action: Provide one standards-compliant RFC3339 parser in mp-model; validate real calendar dates, leap years, time ranges, fractional seconds, and timezone offset ranges; apply offsets when converting to epoch; require strict T separator; reject relaxed space form.
steps.done_when: Valid leap day/Z/fractional/±offsets accepted; invalid calendar/time/offset and space separator rejected.

steps.action: Reuse the shared parser for durable audit timestamps and Raul humanization; remove any second handwritten datetime path in humanize.rs; apply timezone offsets in display conversion.
steps.done_when: Humanize tests cover offset day-boundary cases; no duplicate parser remains.

steps.action: Add crates/mp-model/tests/rfc3339.rs with Finding 11 cases (leap day valid/invalid, month/day/hour/minute/second/offset, ±offsets, fractional, Z, strict T vs space).
steps.done_when: New test binary exists and AC-03 -E filter matches ≥1 passing test; clippy clean.

findings.description: Finding 7B residual: CoApprovalAction::Reject always calls `annotation reopen`, but EnterCoApproval only admits status open|addressed. Real `mp annotation reopen` rejects both (already open / cannot reopen from addressed) and only accepts resolved. Therefore Reject cannot succeed on any annotation the modal can open. Stage-6 tests mask this with a status-agnostic fake mp that always exits 0 on reopen (L1/L2). Fix: implement Reject as a real decline path for open/addressed approval-requests (or gate Reject to resolved-only and allow entry), and add a regression that uses status-faithful mp semantics.

findings.summary: Co-approval Reject never succeeds for enterable annotations
